当应用需要对PDF文档进行编辑操作时使用本Kit的pdfService模块
典型场景包括：在PDF中添加文本和图片、添加水印和页眉页脚、管理书签、添加或删除PDF页面、判断文档加密状态等
当应用需要预览和浏览PDF文档时使用本Kit的PdfView组件
支持页面跳转、缩放、单双页显示、关键字搜索高亮、批注标注等预览交互功能，适合文档阅读器类应用
在应用里加载本地或沙箱中的 PDF 文件并显示第一页 / Load a local or sandbox PDF file in the app and show the first page
实现 PDF 阅读器的连续翻页、缩放和页码跳转 / Implement continuous PDF reading with zoom and page navigation
用 PDF 组件展示合同、说明书或报表文档 / Display contracts, manuals, or reports with a PDF component
读取 PDF 文档目录并跳转到指定书签位置 / Read the PDF outline and jump to a bookmarked section
在 PDF 页面上添加高亮、下划线和手写批注 / Add highlights, underlines, and handwritten annotations on PDF pages
给 PDF 文档插入图片签名、印章或备注文本 / Insert image signatures, stamps, or note text into a PDF document
搜索 PDF 中的关键字并定位到匹配页面 / Search keywords in a PDF and navigate to matching pages
导出 PDF 指定页面为图片缩略图或分享图 / Export selected PDF pages as thumbnails or shareable images
给 PDF 页面添加水印、页眉页脚和背景图层 / Add watermarks, headers, footers, and background layers to PDF pages
删除、插入、重排 PDF 页面并保存修改后的文件 / Delete, insert, reorder PDF pages and save the edited file
保存用户在 PDF 上的批注结果并再次打开继续编辑 / Save user annotations in a PDF and reopen it for further editing
集成 PDF 预览能力用于附件查看和文件审批 / Integrate PDF preview for attachment viewing and document approval
do_not_use_when: 需求是安全保存密码、令牌、密钥等短敏感凭据，并需要属主/群组访问控制或用户认证授权；应改用 asset-store-kit / The requirement is to securely store short sensitive secrets such as passwords, tokens, or keys, with owner/group access control or user authentication; use asset-store-kit instead
需求是定义标准化数据模型、进行跨应用数据共享，或接入向量数据库能力；应改用 arkdata / The requirement is to define standardized data models, share data across apps, or use vector database capabilities; use arkdata instead
preconditions: 应用运行环境位于中国境内，且目标设备为Phone、Tablet或PC/2in1并使用ARM环境 / The app runs in mainland China, and the target device is a Phone, Tablet, or PC/2in1 using an ARM environment
工程已集成PDF Kit相关SDK能力，所用API/组件在当前HarmonyOS版本可用 / The project has integrated the PDF Kit SDK capability, and the required APIs/components are available in the current HarmonyOS version
待处理的PDF文件可被应用访问，相关文件读写权限或URI访问能力已就绪 / The target PDF file is accessible to the app, and the required file read/write permission or URI access capability is ready
inputs: PDF文件路径或URI / PDF file path or URI
PDF页面索引、页码或区域信息 / PDF page index, page number, or region information
编辑或批注内容参数（文本、图片、水印、书签等） / Edit or annotation parameters (text, image, watermark, bookmark, etc.)
outputs: 已打开的PDF文档对象 / Opened PDF document object
保存后的PDF文件或文件流 / Saved PDF file or file stream
编辑后的PDF文档内容 / Edited PDF document content
PdfView预览组件渲染结果 / Rendered PdfView preview output
PDF页面渲染图片（PixelMap） / Rendered PDF page image (PixelMap)
整份PDF转换得到的页面图片列表 / List of page images converted from the full PDF
指定页面或指定区域转换得到的图片 / Image converted from a specified page or region
PDF页面缩略图（PixelMap） / PDF page thumbnail (PixelMap)
文本、图片、页眉页脚、水印或背景等新增页面元素 / Added page elements such as text, images, headers, footers, watermarks, or backgrounds
高亮、下划线、删除线等批注数据 / Annotation data such as highlight, underline, or strikethrough
书签数据（标题、颜色、跳转位置） / Bookmark data including title, color, and destination
PDF页面变更结果（新增页、删除页、导入页后的文档） / PDF page update result after adding, deleting, or importing pages
关键字搜索结果（页码、命中区域、匹配文本） / Keyword search results including page number, matched region, and matched text
高亮显示区域数据 / Highlighted region data
PDF加密状态布尔结果 / Boolean PDF encryption status result
解除加密后的PDF文档 / Decrypted PDF document

postconditions.statement: 已在代码中引入并调用PDF Kit相关接口或PdfView组件以处理PDF文档 / The code imports and invokes PDF Kit APIs or the PdfView component to handle the PDF document
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify code that uses PDF Kit APIs or the PdfView component for a PDF-related task?

postconditions.statement: 实现结果与目标PDF操作一致，如打开/保存、预览、编辑、批注、搜索高亮或转图片中的至少一种 / The implementation matches the intended PDF operation, such as open/save, preview, edit, annotate, search-highlight, or convert to image
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is at least one intended PDF operation implemented end-to-end using PDF Kit?

postconditions.statement: 如涉及文件输出或文档修改，代码包含保存结果、导出结果或更新后的文档处理流程 / If file output or document modification is involved, the code includes saving, exporting, or handling the updated document result
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task modifies a PDF or generates images, do the edits include a concrete save/export/result-handling step?
